entities.summary: The University "Marta Abreu" of Las Villas is an undergraduate and graduate public university in Santa Clara, Cuba, founded in 1952 and having a remote campus called "Universidad de Montaña" in Topes de Collantes, the heart of the Escambray Mountains.
